# Godrej Barça Phase 2 at Godrej MSR City — GX Properties

> Information site by GX Properties, an authorised channel partner marketing Godrej Barça Phase 2 at Godrej MSR City, Yerthiganahalli, Shettigere, North Bengaluru 562157. Not the official website of Godrej Properties Limited.

## Key facts
- Project: Godrej Barça Phase 2, Godrej MSR City (62-acre township by Godrej Properties)
- Location: Shettigere, North Bengaluru, about 15 minutes from Kempegowda International Airport
- Homes: 805 residences in Phase 2; 2 & 3 BHK, approx. 1,200–2,275 sq ft
- Indicative starting prices: 2 BHK from ₹1.59 Cr*, 3 BHK up to about ₹2.99 Cr* (subject to change)
- Booking: Expression of Interest (EOI) of ₹1 Lakh for priority unit selection
- Phase 1: about 1,450 homes worth ₹2,000 crore sold at launch (Angel One, 24 June 2025)
- NRIs: live video tour scheduled at the buyer's convenience
- Contact: GX Properties, +91 77602 87733 (WhatsApp)
